bug_report:

bool test(char c)
{
    return (((0x80 & (c&0xff)) != 0) && ((0xc0 & (c&0xff)) ==  0x80));
}

This is getting optimized to:

test(char):
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

<source>:4:38: warning: comparison is always 0 [-Wtautological-compare]
    4 |     return (((0x80 & (c&0xff)) != 0) && ((0xc0 & (c&0xff)) ==  0x80));
      |            ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
